listing.name: Blast Wind / omegakatana92 Saturn recomp
listing.summary: A native Windows x64 and Linux/Steam Deck port of Blast Wind (Japan) for the Sega Saturn, built by static recompilation with satrecomp. The SH-2 code is translated to C++ and runs on a custom machine with CD-DA and SCSP audio, launcher, saves and full controller support. No emulator, no BIOS and no game data: players supply their own disc. GPL-3.0.
